description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to the CustomView module of VTiger CRM. It includes functions for verifying form data, handling form cancellation, null check validation, and controlling the display of date filter options based on user permissions.

methods.name: verify_data()
methods.description: Validates that the viewName field is not empty before form submission.

methods.name: CancelForm()
methods.description: Redirects to the module index page based on selected module and view ID.

methods.name: check4null(form)
methods.description: Checks if the subject field is empty and prompts the user if so.

methods.name: standardFilterDisplay()
methods.description: Enables or disables date filter inputs depending on user permissions and selected options.
